Name: Map Event Markers
Author: irocendar
Description:
Marks pending player events on the map with question marks.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
This mod will place a '?' marker on the map wherever there is an event that can be triggered right now. This may include currently locked areas. Compatible with Ridgeside Village and World Maps Everywhere.

[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.
[*]Works in single player. Not tested in multiplayer yet.
[/list]
